_comment: Per-camera PIXEL calibration for the CCTV fallback. GAP: docs/SITE_CONTRACT.md carries no calibration fields on cameras[], so this is a cues-owned file — a wrong calibration must be fixable without editing site geometry. refBoxHeightPx is the bounding-box height, in pixels, of refClass standing at refRangeM in this camera's frame. These values are DERIVED FROM NOTHING MEASURED: no camera was calibrated in this run, so a pixel cue from them is a demonstration of the projection, not a survey-grade fix.
